name: Agents Anywhere 远程助手
description: 基于 Agents Anywhere 平台实现手机端对 Pi Desktop 的远程查看、发问与控制，支持扫码一键连接。

en.name: Agents Anywhere Remote
en.description: Remote control and sync for Pi Desktop from mobile via Agents Anywhere. Supports QR code scan to connect.
en.safetyNotes: Connector credentials stay on this local machine. Network communication connects strictly to the official/configured Agents Anywhere relay servers over encrypted WSS/HTTPS. Remote actions reuse local session permissions and never bypass host boundaries.

zh-CN.name: Agents Anywhere 远程助手
zh-CN.description: 基于 Agents Anywhere 平台实现手机端对 Pi Desktop 的远程查看、发问与控制，支持扫码一键连接。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 连接凭据仅保存在本机；网络通信严格限制在官方或用户配置的 Agents Anywhere 中继服务器（通过加密 WSS/HTTPS 传输）；远程执行的指令完全复用本地会话权限体系，绝不绕过安全沙箱。

safetyNotes: 连接凭据仅保存在本机；网络通信严格限制在官方或用户配置的 Agents Anywhere 中继服务器；远程执行指令完全遵循本地权限审批策略。
